top_findings.title: HTTP status codes are never appropriate — every response returns 404
top_findings.evidence: src/main.cpp:27 registers only setDefaultHandler and never addHandler, so server.cpp:169 handlers_.find() always misses and control falls to the default branch at server.cpp:174-177 which hardcodes status_code=404. handleRequest (src/handler.cpp:136) returns only a body string, so 201/400/404-semantic codes are impossible. Successful GET /books, POST /books, and even GET /health all return HTTP 404.
top_findings.suggestion: Have handleRequest return a status code alongside the body and pass it to generateResponse; return 201 on create, 400 on validation failure, 404 for missing book.

top_findings.title: GET /books emits malformed JSON — isbn string is unterminated
top_findings.evidence: src/handler.cpp:211 ends the list element with `<< jsonEscape(book.isbn) << "}"` — the closing quote of the isbn string is missing. The correct single-book path at src/handler.cpp:264 ends with `<< "\"}"`. GET /books therefore returns invalid JSON.
top_findings.suggestion: Change line 211 to close the isbn string, matching line 264.
